{{Quote|Make no mistake, captain&hellip; I will hold ''you'' personally responsible for any incompetence.|Darth Vader, when referring to the mission his force was about to undertake|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
A '''stormtrooper captain''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]], along with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during a [[Duel on Kalakar Six|mission]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kalakar Six]]. While on the moon, the captain was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Captain, two of your men will accompany me to search the fortress. The rest of you split into teams and reconnoiter the surrounding area.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|Darth Vader and the stormtrooper captain|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
[[File:StormtrooperKilledResurrection.png|thumb|right|250px|Darth Maul beheaded the stormtrooper captain.]]
A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Resurrection" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the captain, along with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and a [[Company/Legends|company]] of stormtroopers, went on a [[Duel on Kalakar Six|mission]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kalakar Six]] in order to recover the [[Death Star plans/Legends|schematics]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]<ref name="Resurrection" /> [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that the Alliance had previously stolen. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader warned the captain that, in case the mission were to fail, he would hold the stormtrooper responsible.<ref name="Resurrection" />

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] left with two stormtroopers to explore a [[Unidentified fortress|fortress]] on the moon, leaving the captain with the duty of reconnoitering the surrounding area. The captain gave the order to the stormtrooper company to stay in voice contact via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and to go back to their [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]] in two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Several of the stormtroopers then claimed that they disliked Kalakar Six, leading the captain to silence them and remind them of their duty. The captain also claimed that Darth Vader would not fail the [[Palpatine/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and that they would in turn not fail Vader. Soon after, however, the captain was [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] by the [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the former Sith Lord [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who was on the moon in order to try and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Vader and take his place as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="Resurrection" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Cut the chatter. We're here with a job to do. The mission was assigned to Lord Vader by the Emperor himself.|The stormtrooper captain silences his companions' complaining about the mission|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
The stormtrooper captain was determined to complete his mission, even in the face of hesitation from the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] under their [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]]. The captain was also afraid of how Vader might react if they failed the mission.<ref name="Resurrection" />

==Equipment==
The captain wore [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] with a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] over the right shoulder and wielded an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Resurrection" />

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper captain appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story "[[Resurrection (comic story)|Resurrection]]," published in the [[Star Wars Tales 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' comic series by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Resurrection" /> on [[October 10]], [[2001]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53987/star_wars_tales_1999_9|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #9}}</ref> The comic was written by [[Ron Marz]] and illustrated by [[Rick Leonardi]].<ref name="Resurrection" />
